headline: China's Top Three Airlines Head for Full-Year Losses on High Fuel Costs
summary: China's top three airlines are heading for full-year net losses as elevated fuel costs weigh heavily on their financial performance.
why: Jet fuel represents a major operating expense for airlines, and elevated fuel prices directly compress profit margins across the aviation sector.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: High fuel costs reduce profitability and drive full-year losses for carriers.
